A scent that is as sexy and iconic as its inspiration. Cher Decades 60's body spray is for both men and women. This popular body mist perfume is one of the best fragrances to exude confidence, dignity and individuality. On one level flirty and sensual, on another meditative and serene, the scent defies a single category, like Cher herself. With refreshing and slightly fruity notes of sparkling bergamot, delicate rose damascena, sensual amber and patchouli, this spray is pleasing and comfortable. This perfume has a scent profile that is woody, floral, and perfect for everyday use or special occasions, lasting through the day to keep you smelling like an icon. Cher Decades 60's spray fragrance is cruelty-free and unisex, meant to be enjoyed by everyone. You can capture the free spirit of the 1960's with Cher Decades 60’s body spray. Cher has been the embodiment of feminine power; a style icon, bending fashion to her will; and a model of openness and warmth. A scent that is as sexy and iconic as its inspiration. Cher Decades 60's body spray is for both men and women. This popular body mist perfume is one of the best fragrances to exude confidence, dignity and individuality. On one level flirty and sensual, on another meditative and serene, the scent defies a single category, like Cher herself. With refreshing and slightly fruity notes of sparkling bergamot, delicate rose damascena, sensual amber and patchouli, this spray is pleasing and comfortable. This perfume has a scent profile that is woody, floral, and perfect for everyday use or special occasions, lasting through the day to keep you smelling like an icon. Cher Decades 60's spray fragrance is cruelty-free and unisex, meant to be enjoyed by everyone. You can capture the free spirit of the 1960's with Cher Decades 60’s body spray. Cher has been the embodiment of feminine power; a style icon, bending fashion to her will; and a model of openness and warmth. Most importantly, she has been a voice for those who’ve felt voiceless, a champion of individuality and inclusivity. It is that warmth and caring, more than any degree of star power, that shines strongest through her signature scent. Her grace and humility, her insight and inner romantic: they are the base notes for her most beautiful composition yet. Scent Beauty is on a mission to redefine the perfume industry. Fragrance should mean scent. It is no longer just perfume: the beauty of scent can be experienced in many forms, and we are here to explore all of them, in collaboration with world-renowned celebrities, fashion designers, perfume artisans, and cultural icons.
